cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)

if(POLICY CMP0175)
    cmake_policy(SET CMP0175 OLD)
endif()

find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_EXPORT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_INJECT_DEBUG_POSTFIX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_M3D_IMPORTER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_M3D_EXPORTER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_NO_PBRT_EXPORTER ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ASSIMP_BUILD_MINIZIP ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/assimp)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/freetype)
if (NOT TARGET Freetype::Freetype)
    add_library(Freetype::Freetype ALIAS freetype)
endif ()
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/entt)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/filedialog)
set(ENABLE_HLSL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_GLSLANG_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/glslang)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/cxxopts)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/VulkanMemoryAllocator)
set(TARGET_UNIT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_HELLO_WORLD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_PERFORMANCE_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_VIEWER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/JoltPhysics/Build)
set(RECASTNAVIGATION_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(RECASTNAVIGATION_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(RECASTNAVIGATION_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/recastnavigation)
set(BUILD_TEST_APP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/efsw)
set(BUILD_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_LUA_BINDINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(NO_FONT_INTERFACE_DEFAULT ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${VENDOR_DIR}/RmlUi)
# Discord RPC
if (WIESEL_ENABLE_DISCORD_RPC)
    set(DISCORD_RPC_SOURCES
            ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/discord_rpc.cpp
            ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/rpc_connection.cpp
            ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/serialization.cpp
    )
    if (WIN32)
        list(APPEND DISCORD_RPC_SOURCES
                ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/connection_win.cpp
                ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/discord_register_win.cpp
        )
    else ()
        list(APPEND DISCORD_RPC_SOURCES
                ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/connection_unix.cpp
                ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src/discord_register_linux.cpp
        )
    endif ()
    add_library(discord-rpc STATIC ${DISCORD_RPC_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(discord-rpc PUBLIC ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/include)
    target_include_directories(discord-rpc PRIVATE ${VENDOR_DIR}/discord-rpc/src)
    target_include_directories(discord-rpc PRIVATE ${VENDOR_DIR}/rapidjson/include)
    if (WIN32)
        target_link_libraries(discord-rpc PRIVATE psapi advapi32)
    endif ()
endif ()
